question: Which of the following states registered the highest growth in literacy rate during 2001-2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **15th** official **census in India was calculated in the year 2011.**
 
• The literacy rate of Bihar in the **2001 **census was **47**% .
 
• Whereas the literacy rate of Bihar in the **2011 **census is **61.8**% which is **14.8%** higher than the previous census.
 
• Male and female Literacy rates were** 59.68% and 33.12 % respectively in 2001 which turned to 71.2% and 51.5 % in the 2011 census.**
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli registered the highest growth rate of 18.61% among the Union Territory** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **74.04%** - Literacy Rate of the whole of India according to Census 2011

 
 
• **Male Literacy Rate**- 82.14%
 
• **Female Literacy Rate**- 65.46%
 
• **The highest Literacy rate was seen in U.T**.- Lakshadweep
 
• **Lowest Literacy rate seen in U.T**.- Dadra & Nagar Haveli 
 
• **Kerala** has the highest Literacy state according to Census 2011.
 
• **Bihar** has the Lowest Literacy state according to Census 2011.
